title: wsMed
text: wsMed() function automates full workflow two-condition within-subject mediation analysis. main steps : Validate inputs – check dataset structure, mediation model type (form), missing-data settings. Prepare data – compute difference scores (Mdiff, Ydiff) centered averages (Mavg) two-condition variables. Build model – generate SEM syntax according chosen structure:     Fit model – estimate parameters handling missing data: "DE": listwise deletion "FIML": full-information ML "MI": multiple imputation Compute inference – provide confidence intervals using: Bootstrap (ci_method = "bootstrap") Monte Carlo (ci_method = "mc") Optional: Standardization – standardized = TRUE, return standardized effects CIs. Optional: Covariates – automatically center include: -subject covariates (C): mean-centered added regressions. Within-subject covariates (C_C1, C_C2): difference scores centered averages computed included. dataset wide format, participant separate columns measurements different conditions. Specifically, mediator variable (e.g., M1) split two columns: one Condition 1 one Condition 2. Similarly, outcome variable also separate columns condition. structure ensures within-subject changes can properly analyzed.
